notes:
Account summary
- Prospect: Lattice AI (mid-market). Building enterprise search + assistant features (heavy embeddings + reranking, plus chat for end-user Q&A).
- Current pain: incidents during model/runtime upgrades with existing provider; they now require phased rollouts with measurable gates for ANY change impacting inference (model version, runtime build, routing policy, batching/caching config).
- Buying motion: engineering-led evaluation with security + change-management sign-off required. Timeline driven by their Q2 product launch.

Workload / technical requirements (from discovery + 02/06 deep dive)
- Mix: embeddings (high QPS), reranking (latency-sensitive), chat (streaming).
- Latency targets (stated informally): rerank p95 < ~150ms, embeddings p95 < ~250ms, chat p95 TTFT < ~1.2s and steady token latency; they care most about tail spikes and saturation behavior.
- Throughput: expects bursty traffic during weekday business hours; wants predictable reserved capacity with headroom guidance ("don’t make us guess how much to reserve").
- Routing: wants deterministic routing during rollout (no surprise cross-region shifts); if a region is impaired, wants explicit behavior documented.

Primary blocker: Dedicated rollout safety
- Quote (02/06): "We can’t push a new model build into a reserved pool without a canary stage and automated rollback. That’s how we got burned last time."
- They specifically asked whether staged rollouts apply to:
  - model version changes (weights)
  - runtime builds (kernel/engine updates)
  - routing policies / fallback changes
  - config changes (batching, cache, quant profile)

Desired staged rollout plan defaults (what they asked for)
- Stage sequence preference: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% (traffic-based), OR replica partitions when the pool is small.
- "Hold" state between stages for manual checks + business-approval windows.
- Automatic abort/rollback when gates fail, with a clean audit trail and a one-click "revert to previous stage" story.

Desired per-stage gates (requested as minimum set)
- Error rate: request_error_rate <= 0.5% over rolling 10–15m window (they will accept a tiered threshold if justified).
- Tail latency: p99 latency not worse than baseline by >10% (or absolute cap for reranking endpoints); asked for both p95 and p99.
- Saturation/headroom: GPU utilization and queue depth must stay under defined caps; they called out a prior canary that "starved the rest of the pool" and caused 429s.
- OOM / eviction signals: OOM rate must be near-zero; also wants visibility into KV cache pressure signals where relevant.
- Drop/429: 429 rate must not increase during canary; they want explicit gating on 429s rather than treating it as generic error.
- Missing telemetry behavior: they do NOT want silent pass. Prefer fail-closed + explicit operator override with audit logging.

Audit / compliance notes
- Not fully regulated, but has enterprise customers requiring change control.
- Needs:
  - SSO/SAML for Console access
  - Audit logging that includes rollout create/update/promote/abort/hold/force-promote, with actor + reason + old/new stage
  - Export to SIEM (they asked about event retention + export format; ok with JSON)

What we showed / promised (be careful)
- We presented the staged rollouts for Dedicated pools project as in-progress with a limited beta. We did NOT promise GA date; we did say "aiming for GA after dogfood + a couple design partners".
- We referenced a Console workflow where each stage displays gate evidence (queries, time window, observed vs threshold) and promotion buttons with RBAC.

Risks / watch-outs
- Pool size: they may start with a smaller reserved pool; replica partitioning constraints could limit the granularity of stages (need to set expectations on minimum pool size for safe canary).
- Gate strictness: they want tight thresholds; SRE may push back on too-sensitive gates for bursty workloads (need alignment on evaluation window + minimum sample size).
- Region behavior: they asked for deterministic region routing. If we use multi-region pools, we need a crisp story for "one region impaired mid-stage".

Next steps (proposed)
1) Bring Lattice into beta enablement list once feature flag scoping is ready (account + pool level).
2) Book working session: review default gate thresholds and what is configurable in v1; confirm missing-metrics behavior + override permissions.
3) Share: draft rollout plan template + example gate evidence output (sanitized) + audit event examples.
